description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans clustering membership table implementations using Cassandra as the backend. It includes tests for inserting, reading, updating, and cleaning up membership entries, as well as testing TTL behavior and multi-table scenarios.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringTableTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the functionality of Cassandra-backed Orleans membership table operations, covering scenarios such as insert, read, update, cleanup, and TTL behavior.

methods.name: CreateMembershipEntryForTest

methods.description: Returns the current UTC DateTime with second-level resolution.

methods.name: CreateSiloAddressForTest
